The aim of the 7-semester course is to train environmental engineers

notes: The programme's own page states an application deadline ("Application deadline: 02 February 2026") but only in connection with the Diaspora Scholarship and the Stipendium Hungaricum/Christian Young People scholarship applications ("The application period has ended!"), and it does not say the deadline is for non-EU or foreign-qualification applicants, so the intakes fact is left out. The self-financed route is only a link ("You can apply as a TUITION FEE PAYING student by clicking here.") which does not name a platform; the Tempus Studyfinder page mentions "Study in Hungary link" but no application platform, so the applicationChannel fact is left out. No tuition fee figure for this programme appears on either page (tuition fees page of the site is not supplied), so tuition is left out. No document list appears on either page, so the documents fact is left out. The duration quote "7 semesters" comes from the programme's Description/Entrance block on the Studyfinder page and from the programme's own page.
